senses.gloss: केवल- + आत्मन् केवल- + आत्मन्, m. being the absolute unity, Kumāras. 2, 4.

† केव् केव्, i. 1, Ātm. To serve.
 --Cf. खेव्, सेव्.

केवल केवल, i. e. एके (old loc. sing. of एक) + वल,
 I. adj., f. ला (ved. ली).
 1. Exclusively proper; वीक्षस्व यद्रूपं मम केवलम्, Look what shape is proper only to me, Rām. 5, 35, 52; Bhāg. P. 6, 4, 26.
 2. Mere, Man. 2, 199; nothing but, 3, 118.
 3. Alone, only, Pañc. v. d. 12.
 4. United, i. e. entire, MBh. 13, 2686; whole, 4, 1485; all, Man. 2, 95.
 II. लम्, adv.
 1. Only, Pañc. 31, 7.
 2. Entirely (?), Rām. 2, 87, 23; न केवलम्--अपि, Not only, but also, Rājat. 5, 443.
 III. n. The knowledge of the unity of all the universe.
 IV. m. The name of a prince. Bhāg. P. 9, 2, 30.
 V. f. ली, The name of a locality, MBh. 3, 15245.
केवलिन् केवलिन्, i. e. केवल + इन्, m. One who possesses the knowledge of the universal unity, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 39.
